labeling_notes: All entries are assistant-proposed drafts, not human-approved ground truth. The user supplied initial preferences for BS-1-A; those were simplified where needed.
For BS-1-A spending_summary, amount is KEEP rather than AGGREGATE because the current simple path should preserve transaction values and aggregation behavior is not assumed.
For BS-1-A spending_summary, merchant is KEEP rather than GENERALIZE because the current semantics do not guarantee semantic merchant-to-category mapping.
For BS-1-A spending_summary, balance and transaction_date are DROP; account identifier and internal/personal contact details are DROP unless the policy floor permits DROP or MASK_PARTIAL.
Absent-category labels are placeholders and should not be included in action-agreement scoring.
Identity-check cases and entries marked ambiguous require explicit human review of the task criterion.
Government IDs and full account/card identifiers are restricted to DROP or MASK_PARTIAL by policy.
